title: Bound the session-scoped Git status panel cache
outcome: The module-level Git status cache is keyed by project, session, and workdir but has no eviction. Long-running control rooms that visit many sessions can retain full status snapshots and expansion maps indefinitely. Add bounded eviction or lifecycle invalidation at the narrowest correct cache scope.
acceptance: Cache growth is bounded across session churn; active/recent panel cache behavior remains correct; tests cover eviction and revisit behavior.
